verdict.rationale: A first-party CLI exists (smithery-cli) with commands to search the registry, add server connections, and call tools — covering the 'install into agents' step — but the publish/build/deploy steps described in docs (URL method, MCPB bundle, server-card.json) are framed as a web-based publishing flow rather than CLI subcommands, and no CLI authenticate/build/push commands are evidenced. Missing for 10: CLI login/auth command, CLI build-and-stage command, CLI push/publish command, and independent confirmation that the full authenticate→build→push→install pipeline runs end-to-end from the CLI.
